notes: Identity independently checked against supplied reference: title A Replication and Extension of the PEERS Intervention: Examining Effects on Social Skills and Social Anxiety in Adolescents with Autism Spectrum Disorders; Schohl, Van Hecke, Carson, Dolan, Karst, Stevens; DOI 10.1007/s10803-013-1900-1; marked ORIGINAL PAPER, Springer 2013.
